name: salon-reservation-oss
description: A small, self-hostable reservation app for Cloudflare Workers.

OWNER_TOKEN.description: Create a unique owner secret with `openssl rand -base64 32`; never keep or reuse the sample value.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: The sample is demo-only. Replace it with the secret from [Turnstile Spin](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/spin/) before enabling live bookings.

scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run types:check && npm run build && npm run audit && npm run release:audit
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:worker
